decisions.reason: Mixing quality and consistent foam are stated as reasons for selecting smaller bowls and are already captured by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE; the source does not change those quality targets.
The bowl-capacity decision does not change the existing requirement to minimize splashing.
Preferring smaller bowls for aesthetics is compatible with the existing enclosure-size constraint but does not modify the required side-profile thickness or enclosure-size limit.
The source notes that oversized bowls detract from the design, but it does not change the existing DJ-turntable visual theme.
The bowl-capacity decision contains no change to the machine's color or finish.
Changing bowl capacity does not alter the requirement that the bottom seal prevent liquid from reaching electronics.
The system-layout deliverable remains required unchanged; bowl capacity is owned by the source Requirement and need not be duplicated as a deliverable attribute.
The smaller-bowl selection does not change the required open/close dispensing mechanism.
The source does not change the requirement for a removable or easily flushed spout.
The selected bowl capacity does not alter the leak-containment requirement for the bowl and plumbing seals.
The source changes bowl capacity but does not modify controlled-pour, dripping, or flow-rate requirements.
The bowl-capacity and aesthetic decision does not change the required placard title.
